Bug_Title: NP: Method does not check for null argument (NP_ARGUMENT_MIGHT_BE_NULL)
Bug_Details:
A parameter to this method has been identified as a value that should
always be checked to see whether or not it is null, but it is being dereferenced
without a preceding null check.
Bug_Explanation: The method concatenateStrings is called without checking if the input parameters str1 and str2 are null. This directly leads to a NullPointerException when the concat method is called on a null object.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases trigger the bug by passing null values to the showBug method. These tests fail due to a NullPointerException, which occurs because the concatenateStrings method is called without checking if its arguments are null.
